submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively when the current token continues or completes a familiar conventional chunk: day and month names fire on token identity alone (baseline ~0.35-0.85, e.g. ' March' with no date frame) and peak (~0.75-1.0) inside date/list frames, while function tokens, code keywords, measurement adjuncts and predictable word-pieces (' at' after 'Celsius', 'For i', 'ORDER BY name', 'am|oxicillin', 'hab|ite', 'zer|os') fire only when the constraining left template is present, and clause-final periods fire weakly as closers. The same tokens outside any formulaic template stay near zero (' at' is 0.0 in 'cat sat at sea level', periods 0.0 after random words), and the flat Jacobian/logit lenses (kurtosis ~3.2, only suffix-fragment agreement) promote no coherent upcoming-token set.
